Method of Attack: Social engineering to trick victims into entering a special command that modifies the WoW interface behavior, allowing attackers to execute LUA scripts via chat messages, enabling control over victim's in-game interface, unauthorized trades, and location tracking.
Attack Vector: Victim entering a malicious command (/run RemoveExtraSpaces=RunScript) in the WoW chat interface, which hijacks the RemoveExtraSpaces function to execute attacker-sent LUA scripts.
